judge_reasoning: The response from candidate 1 correctly identifies the major events of Inferno Canto IX: the approach to the walls of Dis (Dite), the arrival of the three Furies, the Medusa threat with Virgilio shielding Dante, the angelic messenger opening the gate, and the entry into the city with the burning tombs of heretics.
